lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four to five parallel horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal spot rows to form a coarse grid-like pattern on the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature along the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance transition with a light upper boundary and a dark shadowed lower boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately five to seven elongated, low-luminance silhouettes with distinct caudal morphology are visible ventral to the pectoral fin.
